access_history.inspected: North Channel protest access was blocked in both directions. The tribal-police statement attributes closure of the bridge system to CBP/CBSA under bridge-corporation authority, exempting emergencies but not local traffic.
access_history.limitation: Indexed body only. The reported protest occupancy ending 16:26 is not equated with first resumed traffic.

sources.title: Seaway bridge closed briefly as part of Canada-wide pipeline protests

access_history.stage: REC50-R31: accepted after separate challenge and root adjudication; original stage: REC50-R31 original research by GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/rounds_protocol; separate challenge and root adjudication pending
access_history.inspected: The North Channel link between Cornwall and Cornwall Island was closed during the afternoon protest. The article reports the bridge reopened by 16:45 according to the Mohawk Council of Akwesasne.
access_history.limitation: The closure site is an approach within the bridge system, not an inferred international-boundary point. No exact reopening clock earlier than the by-16:45 statement is assumed.
